Contact — Contact

Contact [ResStock@nlr.gov](mailto:resstock@nlr.gov), to get your questions answered, request a demonstration, or to learn more about how your organization can realize value from ResStock.

**After May 29, 2026 the ResStock@nrel.gov email address is not valid**, and your email will not be received or responded to. Please use the new team email address [ResStock@nlr.gov](mailto:resstock@nlr.gov) instead.
